name: justinpriday.flutter-tools
description: Worktree-bound Flutter devices, run controls, console, DevTools, and screenshots for Daintree.

scripts.build: node tools/clean-dist.mjs && vite build && node tools/check-panel-bundle.mjs && vite build --config vite.config.worker.ts
scripts.package: npm run licenses && npm run build && node tools/package.mjs
scripts.release:prepare: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run layout:verify && npm run package && npm run validate && npm run audit && node tools/write-release-checksum.mjs
scripts.stage:install: npm run licenses:check && npm run build && node tools/stage-install-dir.mjs
